timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Last night in his interview with Oprah, Prince Harry wore a light gray suit that it turns out is from Jay Crew.
As I was watching, I thought it looked familiar and what gave it away for me were the lapels and the shoulder line.
That and also the fact that it was the same exact suit he wore showing off Baby Archie for the first time.
The suit is indeed the Jay Crew Ludlow suit in Geyser Grey made from Loro Piano Super 120's wool with two buttons,
flat pockets and a double vent, the jacket list for $425 and the pants for $225 so that $650 for the entire suit.
You've got to imagine that given the circumstances, this particular style move was a calculated one.
A former royal shops at the mall just like you, right?
Having owned a couple Loro Suites in the past, I can't say that I'm personally a huge fan.
I've always thought the lapels were a little narrow and the quality didn't quite justify the price.
I like the color though, as you can see in that video down there, we'll show you five different ways to style this suit.
